Studied: Media Production.description:
🎥 You learned to make media: a film club, photography courses, a video editing job or a streaming channel of your own.

🌱 Camera work, lighting, sound and editing. You can catch a fight or a rescue in a clear shot and turn it into something people watch.
⚠️ Live broadcasts under pressure and professional newsroom standards still challenge you.
⚖️ Filming gives no right to cross a police line, careless posting of faces brings complaints, and footage can be taken as evidence.
🏫 It shows in a camera always within reach and a habit of judging light and angles.

📈 Grants: Media Production +15
Studied: Media Production.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied media production: camera work, framing, lighting, sound, editing and publishing, from a short clip to a full report. They can catch a fight or a rescue in a clear shot and turn it into something people watch. Prior study, not mastery: live broadcasts under pressure and professional newsroom standards still challenge them. Not a license: filming gives no right to cross a police line or follow heroes into danger, publishing faces without care brings complaints, and footage can be taken as evidence. It shows in a camera always within reach and a habit of judging light and angles.
